Name: The Weeper
Quirks: speaks with the flat menace of someone who has earned fear rather than sought it
the watering eyes are present and he is aware of people noticing
his hatred of the Night's Watch is specific and personal in ways he does not explain
CharacterDescription: The Weeper also called the Weeping Man is one of the most feared wildling raiders beyond the Wall - a Free Folk war band leader known for gouging out the eyes of Night's Watch rangers and leaving them alive as a message. His eyes run constantly from a condition he was born with which gives him his name. He is not part of Mance Rayder's coalition so much as adjacent to it - he operates by his own code which includes a deep specific hatred of the Night's Watch that goes beyond general Free Folk resentment. He is dangerous the way men who have nothing to prove and nothing to lose are dangerous: without the moderating influence of reputation-management.
AIGeneratedBackstory: The Weeper, also known as the Weeping Man, is a notorious free folk raider and leader of a war band.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: Beyond the Wall raiding two days before Ned Stark's execution.
